About Me
A developer who
thinks like a designer.
Flutter Developer & NTI-Certified UI/UX Designer, building mobile apps since October 2025.

I'm a Flutter Developer and NTI-Certified UI/UX Designer based in Tanta, Egypt. I've been building cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS since October 2025, independently delivering 5+ Flutter apps in under 9 months.

My workflow spans the full product lifecycle — Figma UI/UX design, REST API integration, state management with BLoC / Cubit / Provider, Firebase backend services, local storage, secure authentication, and responsive Material Design. Every project I ship is open-source on GitHub.

Beyond Flutter, I have a solid Computer Science foundation in C++, Object-Oriented Programming, and Data Structures & Algorithms. I'm studying Business Information Systems (BIS) and have completed real-world freelance work — delivering a payroll management system for an actual workshop client from requirements to final delivery.
